_meta.by: sysuse auto; each command, then for each panel k `.Graph.graphs[k].yaxis1.major.min/max/delta', the same for xaxis1, and `.Graph.graphs[k].yaxis1.plotregion.yscale.min/max'
_meta.log: [lo, hi, N, min, max, delta]: 30 values from lo to hi evenly spaced in log, `twoway scatter y x, yscale(log) ylabel(#N)', read from `.Graph.yaxis1.major' (its .trans is 0: the rule is linear natscale over the data); plus sysuse auto price
_meta.overflow: [lo, hi, N, min, max, delta]: two observations lo and hi, `twoway scatter y x, ylabel(#N)', `.Graph.yaxis1.major'; where natscale overflows (tickset_g.class's `natscale fooled' branch) the axis is lo-1 to hi+1
_meta.date_graph: [kind, lo, hi, N, min, max, delta, list]: 30 values of a %t<kind> variable from lo to hi, `twoway scatter y t, xlabel(#N)', `.Graph.xaxis1.major' (list from dlg_tickpos when delta is 0); each equals _tsnatscale lo hi N, <kind> (natscale for %tc)
_meta.tsnatscale: [unit, lo, hi, N, r(min), r(max), r(delta), r(list)] of `_tsnatscale lo hi N, <unit>' over 2,000 random integer ranges per unit (set seed 20260924), and sweeps

by.command: twoway scatter mpg weight, by(foreign) ylabel(#5)
twoway scatter mpg weight, by(foreign) ylabel(#5) xlabel(#4)
twoway scatter mpg weight, by(foreign, yrescale) ylabel(#5)
twoway scatter mpg weight, by(rep78) ylabel(#6)
twoway scatter price weight, by(foreign, total) ylabel(#4)
twoway scatter mpg weight, by(foreign, yrescale xrescale) ylabel(#5) xlabel(#3)
